name: Hanging
overview: The topic of hanging in Scripture is closely connected to capital punishment and the curse associated with death by hanging. In Genesis 40, Pharaoh's chief baker is hanged on a tree as a fulfillment of Joseph's interpretation, illustrating hanging as a form of execution. Deuteronomy 21 further clarifies that if a man is sentenced to death for a serious sin, he may be hung on a tree, but his body must not remain overnight because one who is hanged is considered accursed by God. This highlights both the judicial use of hanging and its spiritual implications as a sign of divine curse.
